note: Small RV park / glampground on a 40-acre homestead (an 1880s frontier village, ministry-run) in the Pine Ridge badlands 16 mi NW of Crawford, backing to the Oglala National Grassland, 3 mi from Hudson-Meng. Reached by miles of county dirt road; the operator warns they 'can be slick when wet' and asks guests to drive 'a vehicle capable of reaching us'. No dump station: arrive with empty tanks. No open fires. The pool was down in 2026. --Claude
summary: Operator's policies page: RV sites $15 dry / $25 electric / $35 E+W or W+S / $40 full hookup (2026 season), reservation only with a 2-night minimum and 30-night maximum, no dump station, well water drinkable; season May 15 - Oct 17 confirmed. Booking platform set to phone; amperage, site count and pull-through not stated (left). Note cleaned of hookup/season text; dirt-road caveat and no-dump line added.
flags: Private gate facts: posted 2026 rates $15-40 (full hookup $40), under US$50, no gateway needed. Presence: operator website with phone 308-665-2592 (matches entry); Google Maps 4.7 stars from 126 reviews, phone +1 308-665-2592. RV Life 5*/$$ (stored). Good Sam: not stated by the operator.
Standing 2-night minimum on every site ('All rooms and sites are reservation only, with a 2-night minimum and 30-day maximum stay') - recorded in booking.min_stay; under the 3-night line, so kept.

Road caveat (not a 4WD statement): 'the roads up to us are dirt. They are maintained by the county, but when it rains or snows they can be slick. Make sure that you are driving a vehicle capable of reaching us' (directions page). No 4WD or high-clearance wording; added to the note.
Long-stay tests: none triggered - nightly rates posted, 30-day maximum stay, season May-October, no seasonal/monthly sites or residents mentioned.

Not stated by the operator: amperage (stored 50, derived from note prose, left), site count, pull-throughs, showers (a 'bathhouse' is listed). The stored 'its own site books online' (inclusion evidence) could not be confirmed: BOOK NOW opens a rooms page with no RV booking engine.
